events.title: Ski Day Trip – Sölden, Austria
events.description: Ski Day Trip – Sölden, Austria Get ready to hit the slopes! Join ODR for a ski day trip to Sölden, Austria, and experience one of the country’s most exciting alpine destinations. With expansive mountain terrain, incredible views, and Sölden’s famous BIG 3 peaks, there’s plenty to explore throughout the day. Whether you’re looking forward to carving your way down the mountain or simply enjoying the atmosphere of an Austrian ski town, it’s a great way to kick off the ski season. Date: December 19, 2026 Cost: $249 per person

events.title: Ski Day Trip – Ischgl, Austria
events.description: Ski Day Trip – Ischgl, Austria Experience an unforgettable day in the Austrian Alps! Join ODR for a ski day trip to Ischgl and the Silvretta Arena, a premier winter destination known for its extensive slopes and incredible mountain scenery. Explore 239 km of slopes, with terrain stretching across the border into Samnaun, Switzerland. Whether you’re looking to cover as much of the mountain as possible, enjoy the high-altitude runs, or experience Ischgl’s lively après-ski atmosphere, there’s plenty to make the most of your day. Date: January 23, 2027 Cost: $259 per person

events.title: Ski Day Trip – Grindelwald, Switzerland
events.description: Ski Day Trip – Grindelwald, Switzerland Experience a day of skiing surrounded by some of Switzerland’s most iconic mountain scenery! Join ODR for a trip to Grindelwald and the Jungfrau Ski Region, set beneath the impressive peaks of the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau. With more than 210km of slopes throughout the region, there’s plenty to explore. Enjoy the wide-open runs around Grindelwald-First, take in the breathtaking Alpine views, or challenge yourself on the famous Lauberhorn downhill course near Wengen. Date: February 6, 2027 Cost: $249 per person

events.title: Ski Day Trip – Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France
events.description: Ski Day Trip – Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France Experience an unforgettable day on the slopes in Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France! Set beneath the towering Mont Blanc, this legendary Alpine destination offers incredible skiing and breathtaking mountain views. Explore Chamonix’s renowned ski area, take on the exciting mountain terrain, and enjoy panoramic views throughout the valley. Whether you’re looking for challenging runs or simply want to experience skiing in one of Europe’s most iconic winter destinations, this trip is sure to be one to remember. Date: February 27, 2027 Cost: $249 per person

events.title: Ski & Après Day Trip – Silvretta Montafon
events.description: Ski & Après Day Trip – Silvretta Montafon Hit the slopes and stay for the music! Join ODR for a day at Silvretta Montafon, combining a full day of skiing with an exciting après-ski experience. Explore 140km of slopes surrounded by beautiful Austrian Alpine scenery before wrapping up the day with live entertainment featuring DJ Big Tim and Pietro Basile. It’s the perfect trip for those looking to enjoy great skiing, music, and a lively mountain atmosphere all in one day. Date: March 13, 2027 Cost: $219 per person

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for Spangdahlem AB reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
